
{{alias}}( dtype, k )
    Returns a new struct constructor tailored to a specified floating-point data
    type.

    Parameters
    ----------
    dtype: string
        Floating-point data type for storing floating-point statistics.

    k: integer
        Number of centroids.

    Returns
    -------
    fcn: Function
        Struct constructor.

    Examples
    --------
    > var S = {{alias}}( 'float64', 3 );
    > var r = new S();
    > r.toString()
    <string>

    See Also
    --------
